cohort: The study included 977 pregnant women, with 141 testing COVID-19 positive and 836 testing COVID-19 negative, at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: The study found no significant effect of COVID-19 infection on maternal and foetal outcomes and no evidence of vertical transmission of the COVID-19 infection.
mod_finding: More patients delivered by LSCS in both the COVID-positive (50%) and COVID-negative (47%) groups, with no statistically significant difference between them (p > 0.05).
followup_time: Day 5 for a subset of neonates retested for COVID-19.
